_meta.source: Curated from CBP ACE Agency Tariff Code Reference (Pub 0875-0419, Dec 5 2019: which agencies set HTS flags, and for which programs) and the agencies' import rules. Not the CBP per-tariff PGA flag file.
_meta.note: Maps HTS prefix (chapter, heading, or subheading) to agencies whose rules may apply. Longest prefix wins. Every action is conditional on what the product is: CBP sets flags at the 10-digit level and most are 'may be required'. Not exhaustive; no match does not mean no agency applies.
